decisions.statement: A turn stating no position sorts after every turn that states one.
A turn with no title of its own is named by the position that turn states.
A turn carries the prose handed here and no prose where none was handed.
The turns drawn are the last twenty, and the rest are counted rather than drawn.
No action box is drawn here, so a game declaring one has that panel left out.
A story no game names draws its prose and no panel beside it.
A story draws its own prose whether or not its game declares that panel.

definition: the turns and chapters a story was played in, shaped into what a display draws
